question: Can a query-blind, public-language-preserving native memory update preserve all F60-executable four-step relationships, while opportunistically improving six-step graph coverage in exactly 144 persistent bytes?
hypothesis: A retention controller can use structural relationship-language signatures of its currently retained records to detect when a legal alternative preserves F60 short-horizon reachability while expanding long-horizon compositional coverage. Frozen F60 is used unchanged whenever there is no demonstrably useful new coverage.

method.online_signature: online(public, PACK, F62, trace=False); each step receives only retained 12-byte records, current public edge and index; never query/answer/private truth/future event/source seed, family or arrival-regime labels.
method.frozen_native_action: Exactly F62.actions(previous_memory, incoming_public_edge, index, PACK), with exact baseline F62._f60_step from the same previous memory. Every chosen candidate must be a legal native state and pass 72-prefix independent auditor.
method.directed_language: For each retained native record, allow its exact forward role/direction code sequence and exact reversed+direction-flipped sequence. Enumerate all endpoint pairs (start,end) and concatenated code sequences formed from existing native records at joins, up to at most 6 code steps. No synthesized edge, hidden label or inferred answer.
method.short_horizon_protection: A legal alternative is eligible only if its COMPLETE set of (start,end,role-code sequence) tuples of lengths 1..4 is IDENTICAL to the F60 baseline memory; neither missing paths nor additional ambiguous short-horizon paths are permitted.
method.novel_six_step_objective: Among eligible alternatives, select only if they have STRICTLY MORE distinct directed language tuples with exactly 6 codes than F60 baseline; select maximal six-step count, then maximal five-step count, then candidate native enumeration order. Otherwise choose the exact F60 baseline. Never use numerical node IDs in score.
method.public_adaptation: Each prefix recomputes language from the retained F60 baseline and the newly reachable legal alternatives, so the rule reacts to public structural changes without knowing source arrival regime. No learned weights, cohort-driven tuning, threshold selection or persistent controller metadata.
method.budget: At most 12 native 12-byte records = 144 persistent bytes, original source codec, native actions, original frozen F85 query solver for all arms; separate ephemeral code enumerator capped at 15000 distinct path states per candidate. Cap exhaustion chooses F60, records cap event, no speculative success.
method.negative_controls: F60/F83/F86/F87B immutable exact native online programs and exact F85 global solver. Unchanged controls never call the new F88 policy. Frozen historical greedy PACK.solve on F88's same final state is diagnostic only.
method.scientific_limitations: An F60 short-horizon language equivalence is not a full guarantee of task accuracy nor independent prospective success; empirical non-degradation is required.

arms: F60 exact frozen 144-byte native memory plus frozen F85 global solver
F83 exact frozen 24-int8 policy memory plus frozen F85 global solver
F86 frozen prior negative policy plus frozen F85 global solver
F87B frozen bridge-reserve negative policy plus frozen F85 global solver
F88 new six-step public-language frontier policy plus frozen F85 global solver
F88 same retained memory plus historic PACK.solve

acceptance.scientific_guard_validity: All 32 synthetic cases source-publicly uniquely solvable; all original source, prereg and frozen method blobs unchanged; native action, exact F60 fallback, <=144B and independent 72-prefix causality passed in every arm.
acceptance.positive_synthetic_mechanism: At least one F60-failed six-step task rescued, no F60-correct case regressed in either arrival regime or question family, no scoring based on future/query/answer.
acceptance.negative_synthetic_mechanism: Any case regression from F60 OR zero six-step rescues OR no legal improvement opportunity despite valid controls. Preserve negative.
acceptance.invalid: Any missing frozen source identity, native parity, offline label in online loop, noncausal trace, retained budget overflow, source answer nonuniqueness or missing cases.
acceptance.no_posthoc_retuning: Once frozen new cohort has been touched, F88 method remains unchanged regardless of negative findings. Later work only via new prereg and fresh disjoint cohort.

authority.source_first_use: unregistered new negative synthetic guard only
